profiles.shortDescription: Piab develops vacuum automation and material-handling equipment for industrial processes. Its official range includes vacuum ejectors and pumps, suction cups, end-of-arm tooling and vacuum conveying systems.
fullDescription: Piab's manufacturer-owned site documents vacuum components and systems used to grip, lift and convey products in automated production.
The portfolio combines vacuum pumps and ejectors, suction cups, robot end-of-arm tooling, accessories and pneumatic conveying solutions for powders and bulk materials.

profiles.shortDescription: PIBIVIESSE manufactures engineered ball valves for energy and process applications. Its official portfolio covers side-entry, top-entry and fully welded valves for on-off and control duties.
fullDescription: The official company site identifies PIBIVIESSE as a specialist ball-valve business that retains its product organization following acquisition by RMT Valvomeccanica.
Its documented range includes trunnion-mounted and engineered ball valves in side-entry, top-entry and fully welded configurations for pipelines and process plants.

profiles.shortDescription: PIBOMULTI designs and manufactures multi-spindle heads and machining units for machine tools. Its systems support simultaneous drilling, tapping and machining operations in compact or large custom configurations.
fullDescription: PIBOMULTI's official product page establishes its Swiss identity and specialization in custom multiple-spindle devices.
The manufacturer engineers axial and angled multi-spindle heads, spindle units and related tooling modules for applications ranging from watchmaking to automotive production.

profiles.shortDescription: Pietribiasi develops processing machinery and complete lines for liquid food and beverage production. Its range includes pasteurization, UHT treatment, mixing, storage, clean-in-place and heat-exchange systems.
fullDescription: Pietribiasi's manufacturer-owned site documents equipment for processing milk and dairy products, ice-cream mixes, juices, soft drinks and beer.
The portfolio covers pasteurizers, UHT units, heat exchangers, tanks, mixing systems, CIP plants and integrated production lines rather than individual catalog products.

profiles.shortDescription: Pietro Fiorentini develops equipment and systems for gas, hydrogen and water networks. Its official range includes pressure regulators, valves, filters, meters, monitoring devices and packaged infrastructure systems.
fullDescription: Pietro Fiorentini's product directory documents components and systems across natural-gas production, transmission and distribution, hydrogen and water infrastructure.
The portfolio includes pressure-control equipment, industrial valves, filtration, metering, gas-quality analysis, network monitoring and integrated pressure-control and metering stations.

profiles.shortDescription: PILOUS manufactures band-sawing equipment for metal and wood processing. Its official range includes metal-cutting band saws, sawmill machines, band-saw blades, deburring machines and material conveyors.
fullDescription: PILOUS' manufacturer-owned site presents machinery for cutting metal stock and processing timber.
The documented portfolio spans manual through automated metal band saws, horizontal sawmills, blades, deburring equipment and handling accessories used around cutting operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Pimatic develops pneumatic components and application-specific automation solutions. Its product range covers cylinders, valves, air-preparation units, fittings and tailored pneumatic assemblies.
fullDescription: Pimatic's official product directory documents components for producing, controlling and distributing compressed-air motion.
The portfolio includes standard and special cylinders, directional and process valves, air preparation, connectors and complete pneumatic solutions engineered for machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: Piovan develops material-handling and process-automation equipment for polymers, food ingredients and industrial powders. Its portfolio includes conveying, drying, dosing, blending, storage, granulation, cooling and control systems.
fullDescription: Piovan's official site documents auxiliary machinery and centralized systems that move, condition and prepare raw materials for industrial processing.
The range covers feeding and conveying, drying and dehumidifying, dosing and blending, temperature control, storage, granulation and supervisory software.

profiles.shortDescription: Pister manufactures ball valves and hydraulic valve assemblies for industrial fluid control. Its range includes two-way, three-way and multiway valves, high-pressure and high-temperature designs, plug valves and flow-control solutions.
fullDescription: Pister's official catalog organizes industrial valve technology by function, pressure range, media and installation configuration.
The manufacturer supplies standard and engineered ball valves, control and plug valves, special-material designs and integrated hydraulic valve assemblies.

profiles.shortDescription: PITTLER develops machine tools for turning, milling and combined machining within DVS Technology Group. Its modular systems support rotationally symmetrical components and flexible production cells.
fullDescription: DVS Technology's official company profile identifies PITTLER T&S GmbH and its specialization in turning and milling technology.
The documented machine program combines turning, milling and related machining operations in configurable platforms for industrial series production.

profiles.shortDescription: Pittman is an AMETEK motion-control brand for compact electric motors and geared drives. The current official portfolio includes brushed and brushless DC motors, gearmotors and integrated motion assemblies.
fullDescription: The manufacturer-owned Haydon Kerk Pittman site places Pittman within AMETEK's precision-motion portfolio.
Pittman products cover brushed and brushless DC motors, gearmotor configurations, feedback options and application-specific assemblies used alongside AMETEK linear-motion technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Poclain Hydraulics develops hydrostatic and electrohydraulic transmission components and systems. Its official range includes hydraulic motors, pumps, valves, electronic controls and complete drive solutions.
fullDescription: Poclain's manufacturer-owned product directory documents technologies for converting and controlling hydraulic power in mobile and industrial machinery.
The portfolio covers radial-piston motors, hydraulic pumps and valves, electronic control units, braking functions and integrated hydrostatic or electrohydraulic transmissions.

profiles.shortDescription: Podem is the hoisting-equipment brand continued by Podemcrane AD. Its official range includes electric wire-rope hoists, trolleys, end carriages and crane components.
fullDescription: Podemcrane's official material establishes the company as successor to Podem and documents continued use of the Podem brand.
The product range covers standard and low-headroom wire-rope hoists, travelling trolleys, crane end carriages and components used in overhead lifting systems.

profiles.shortDescription: POLLRICH designs and manufactures customized centrifugal fans for industrial processes. Its systems are configured around required flow, pressure, materials, temperature and operating environment.
fullDescription: POLLRICH's official site establishes the current company identity and its focus on engineered industrial fan technology.
The manufacturer supplies centrifugal fans, fan systems and associated services for process air, exhaust, material handling and demanding gas streams.

profiles.shortDescription: Poly-clip System develops clipping and packaging technology for food and non-food production. Its portfolio includes automatic and semi-automatic clipping machines, loaders, labelling equipment, vacuum systems and consumables.
fullDescription: Poly-clip System's official product finder documents machinery that closes and handles filled casings, bags and nets.
The range combines clipping machines and lines with loaders, labelling systems, vacuum equipment, automation accessories and matched clips and loops.

profiles.shortDescription: Pomac manufactures hygienic pumps for liquid handling in sanitary process installations. Its range includes centrifugal, lobe, twin-screw, liquid-ring, self-priming and channel pumps.
fullDescription: Pomac's official site documents stainless-steel pumping equipment designed for cleanability and sanitary process duties.
The portfolio covers several pump principles for low- and high-viscosity liquids, entrained air, gentle transfer and clean-in-place operation in food, pharmaceutical and chemical plants.

profiles.shortDescription: POMTAVA manufactures precision gear pumps and dosing systems for industrial liquids. Its range also includes flowmeters, pressure instrumentation, valves, fittings, mixing heads and color-change components.
fullDescription: POMTAVA's official company page establishes its 1986 founding in Switzerland and specialization in high-precision gear-pump dosing.
The documented portfolio supports paints, adhesives, sealants, polyurethane, composites and chemical processes with metering pumps and compatible control and mixing accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: PONAR Wadowice manufactures hydraulic components and complete oil-hydraulic systems. Its portfolio includes directional and pressure-control valves, pumps, motors, cylinders, filters, accumulators, heat exchangers and power units.
fullDescription: PONAR Wadowice's official product directory identifies the exact company and documents a broad fluid-power portfolio for industrial and mobile applications.
The manufacturer combines hydraulic valves and drives with filtration, cooling, energy-storage components, electronic controls and engineered hydraulic systems.

profiles.shortDescription: POWER-GENEX manufactures valve-positioning and pneumatic control accessories. Its official range includes smart and electro-pneumatic positioners, valve position monitors, boosters, relays and air-control components.
fullDescription: POWER-GENEX's official site identifies the Korean production and research company and documents its automatic-valve accessory portfolio.
Products include digital and analog positioners for linear and rotary actuators, limit-switch boxes, volume boosters, snap-acting relays and related pneumatic accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: PPI Pumps manufactures industrial vacuum and process-pumping equipment. Its official range includes liquid-ring vacuum pumps, single-cone and two-stage systems, roots blowers and chemical-process pumps.
fullDescription: PPI Pumps' manufacturer-owned site documents vacuum generation and fluid-handling equipment for process plants.
The portfolio includes liquid-ring and two-stage vacuum pumps, roots blowers, ejector and packaged vacuum systems, and selected centrifugal and chemical-process pumps.

profiles.shortDescription: Pratissoli is an Interpump Group brand for high- and very-high-pressure reciprocating pumps. Its portfolio includes plunger and piston pumps, valves, accessories and pumping systems for demanding industrial duties.
fullDescription: Pratissoli's official site identifies the brand within Interpump Group and documents high-pressure pumping technologies.
The range covers horizontal and vertical plunger and piston pumps, pump-control valves, drive components and accessories for water jetting, process and service applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Precision Chains manufactures engineered conveyor and transmission chains for bulk-material and process industries. Its portfolio includes application-specific chains, sprockets, attachments and replacement assemblies.
fullDescription: Precision Chains' manufacturer-owned site and official catalogs document chain systems engineered around abrasive, high-load and continuous-process duties.
The supported scope includes conveyor chains and matched components for grain, sugar, cement, asphalt, wood-processing and other bulk-handling machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: PRESSOL manufactures lubrication and fluid-handling equipment for workshops and industry. Its range includes grease guns and pumps, oilers, transfer pumps, meters, dispensing systems and equipment for diesel and urea solutions.
fullDescription: PRESSOL's official product and catalog pages document tools and systems for storing, transferring, measuring and dispensing lubricants and service fluids.
The portfolio spans manual and powered grease and oil equipment, workshop dispensers, fluid meters, tanks and pumps for diesel, AdBlue and related media.

profiles.shortDescription: Prinzen is a Vencomatic Group brand for egg-handling and packing automation. Its product scope includes egg packers, graders, tray stackers, palletisers and transport systems.
fullDescription: Vencomatic Group's official brand page establishes Prinzen as its egg-handling equipment identity.
The brand's systems automate collection, orientation, grading, tray packing, stacking, palletising and transfer between stages of poultry and hatchery operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Proceq is a Screening Eagle Technologies brand for portable non-destructive testing and inspection equipment. Its documented scope covers concrete assessment, ground-penetrating radar, ultrasonic imaging, hardness testing and surface inspection.
fullDescription: Screening Eagle's official company brochure connects the Proceq identity and its Swiss NDT heritage to the current group.

profiles.shortDescription: PROCON is a Standex brand for compact positive-displacement rotary-vane and gear pumps. Its pumps serve beverage, water-treatment, medical, cooling and industrial fluid-transfer applications.
fullDescription: PROCON's official site identifies the pump business within Standex and documents its rotary positive-displacement technologies.
The range includes rotary-vane pumps, gear pumps, motors and accessories configured for clean liquids, controlled pressure and continuous duty in OEM equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Produal develops measurement and control devices for building automation and HVAC systems. Its portfolio includes sensors, transmitters, room controllers, thermostats, valves, actuators and meters.
fullDescription: Produal's official site and product catalog document instruments and controls used to measure indoor conditions and regulate building services.
The range covers temperature, humidity, pressure, air-quality and occupancy sensing together with room controllers, thermostats, valve actuators and system accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: PROTEGO manufactures explosion-protection and tank-safety equipment for industrial process systems. Its range includes flame arresters, pressure and vacuum valves, emergency vents and tank accessories.

The product scope covers end-of-line and in-line flame arresters, conservation vents, pressure-vacuum relief valves, emergency relief devices and accessories for storage and process installations.

profiles.shortDescription: ProXES develops processing machinery and complete lines for food, pharmaceutical, cosmetics and advanced-material applications. Its technologies include mixing, homogenizing, emulsifying, grinding, cutting, heating and cooling.
fullDescription: ProXES' official product directory combines the FrymaKoruma, Stephan and Terlet process-technology portfolios under the ProXES group identity.
The manufacturer supplies standalone machines and integrated lines for mixing, fine cutting, wet grinding, emulsification, homogenization, thermal treatment and product handling.

profiles.shortDescription: Prysmian develops cable systems and connectivity products for energy and telecommunications networks. Its portfolio covers power transmission and distribution, optical fibre, telecom cables, industrial cables and network accessories.
fullDescription: Prysmian's official product centre documents cable and connectivity technologies for electrical grids, digital networks, construction, transport and specialist industries.
The range includes high-, medium- and low-voltage cable systems, submarine and overhead transmission, optical fibre and telecom connectivity, industrial cables and monitoring solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: PS Costruzioni Meccaniche develops automated machinery for winding, handling and packaging cable and wire. Its systems cover coiling, spooling, rewinding, wrapping, palletising and integrated line automation.
fullDescription: The manufacturer's official site documents standalone and complete-line equipment for preparing and packaging cable, wire, tube and similar flexible products.
The portfolio includes coilers, spoolers, winders, pay-offs and take-ups, wrapping machines, palletising cells and custom automated handling systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Pulsotronic develops sensors and connectivity components for industrial automation and mobile equipment. Its portfolio includes inductive, capacitive, optical, ultrasonic, magnetic, radar, inclination and strain-gauge sensors.
fullDescription: Pulsotronic's official company and product pages identify the business as a Phoenix Contact group company focused on sensor and connection technology.
The range combines multiple non-contact sensing principles with connectors, distribution components and customized electronic or electromechanical assemblies.

profiles.shortDescription: PZL-Dębica manufactures industrial refrigeration equipment and systems. Its range includes compressor units, chillers, condensers, air and liquid coolers, refrigeration valves, vessels and complete cold-storage installations.
fullDescription: The official company page identifies Wytwórnia Urządzeń Chłodniczych PZL-Dębica S.A. and documents its specialization in industrial refrigeration.
Its production scope covers reciprocating and screw-compressor packages, liquid chillers, condensers, coolers, tanks, refrigeration valves, freezing tunnels and complete refrigeration plants.

profiles.shortDescription: Qubiqa designs automated end-of-line handling and internal-logistics systems. Its solutions cover packing, stacking, palletising, board handling and material flow for insulation, furniture, panels and biomass.
fullDescription: Qubiqa's official site documents standalone equipment and turnkey automated systems for the final stages of industrial production.
The company integrates mechanical handling, robotics and control software into packing, stacking, palletising and logistics lines for bulky boards, rolls and packaged materials.
